outcome: proportion of prescriptions with supply > 7 days
milligrams of morphine equivalent (MMEs) per delivery
cohort: Participants included 1,572,338 deliveries to enrollees aged 18-44 years in 49 US states between January 1, 2014, and December 31, 2021.
finding: State opioid prescribing limits were not statistically significantly associated with changes in postpartum opioid prescribing.
mod_finding: The lack of association between opioid prescribing limits and postpartum opioid prescribing was consistent regardless of delivery type (vaginal vs cesarean).
